newsitem.title: BULGARIA: France Telecom to bid for Bulgaria's telecom stake.
newsitem.headline: France Telecom to bid for Bulgaria's telecom stake.

text.p: The Bulgarian Posts and Communications Committee (BPCC) said on Friday France Telecom would bid for a 25 percent stake in Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC).
Senior government officials have said the tender for the BTC stake sale would be called at the end of May or at the beginning of June.
"France Telecom expressed its wish to us for a future economic, technical and financial partnership with BTC as a partner," said a BPCC statement.
BPCC chairman Lyubomir Kolarov met visiting senior France Telecom officials on Thursday.
Local financial daily Pari said Deutsche Telecom had also stated its plans to bid in the sale.
BPCC, which wants a good price for the stake sale, said last week it was preparing a tender for a second GSM operator in a bid to stimulate competition between the operators.
Last week the Privatisation Agency received 18 letters of intent for shortlisting of advisors to the government in the BTC sale.
